in a box of text
Bold Italic wraps in its own frame
Area type wraps in its frame and then flows past its last line.
Kalamo用SVG保存「矢量图」，大家一起编辑。ちょっとコーヒーを飲みましょう！
한국어 문장은 음절 사이에서 줄을 바꿉니다. Kalamo로 함께 편집해요!
A Latin line, then Noto Sans SC words, then Latin again

Heading word
body text here
last line
Area Type with a LARGE word in the middle of its lines

Centred title
and a second line
third

Right aligned
lines end here
ok

Justified point type
lays out left
Centred area type wraps each line in the middle of its frame.
Right aligned area type ends every line at the frame's right edge.

Justified area type stretches every line to the frame but the last.
A second paragraph keeps its own last line left.
Words flow in a circle here, each line as wide as the circle is at its band, so the lines grow and then shrink again toward the bottom of it.
A concave frame gives two spans on each band above its notch, so these words fill the left one and then the right one before going below it, where one wide span holds the rest of the words.

Latin line first
then 中文 in Noto
最后 the last
Latin words, then 中文字 and 日本語の文 on the lines after

Shaped Heading
Body words fill the left arm and then the right arm, and 中文字 draws in Noto Sans SC beside them, then below the notch the rest.
Big words open a triangle whose bands narrow, with 汉字 on a later line and a few more words.
Honorificabilitudinitatibus breaks in a triangle too.
Auto Size fits this frame to its lines, however many there are.
Soft hy­phens let in­ter­na­tion­al­ize wrap with no hy­phen.
